.qc-cache/coldwater-strict-2026-10-02-r10/task/tests/**/judge.toml, tests/**/prompt.md, tests/app_context.md, tests/scoring.toml (machine-compared against the public text for ids, probe literals and verbatim overlap)
evidence: Static row; no runtime measurement is required for it. (1) Skill grep recipe from quality-checks.md:26, widened with grader|grading|graded|verifier|gate|likert|points|functional|polish|visual|oracle|harbor|test.sh|scoring|cw_|probe|evaluat|checker|/logs|mcp|CHANGE_ME|TODO|placeholder, run case-insensitively over task/instruction.md, the six environment/instructions notes and environment/assets/seed_data.json: exactly one hit, environment/instructions/security.md:5 'Refuse dynamic evaluation through eval, Function, WebAssembly, ...', which is a product rule about user code, not grader vocabulary. No hit for judge, rubric, criteri, dimension, reward, weight, score.py, playwright, claude, glm, /tests or sentinel. (2) Criterion ids: 54 ids collected from tests/**/judge.toml and the prompts (cw_* and others); none appears in any public file. (3) Probe literals: probe-like tokens in the criteria and prompts (APP_RESTART_HELPER, MULTI, restart_app, localStorage, sessionStorage, 1440, 844, 9000 and others) are absent from the public text; the only shared values are 3000 (the port, integration.md:3) and 390 (phone width, ui.md:17), both runtime or product requirements a builder needs rather than grader sentinels, plus generic words CDN, CSS, DOM, HTML, SVG. (4) Verbatim overlap: no shared run of 10 or more words between any public file and any tests/ toml or md; at 7 words the single shared run is 'the preview the console and the library' (ui.md:17 vs tests/scored/polish/judge.toml), an ordinary list of product areas. (5) Paths the brief names are builder-facing only: /instructions, /assets/seed_data.json, /app, / (instruction.md:3,5), and /app/server.js, /api/health, /app/app.db, DB_PATH, NODE_PATH (integration.md:3-9). These are the launch contract; no /tests, /logs/verifier or scoring path is named. (6) seed_data.json holds an empty snippets array and a plain product note. Weak-app probe: a builder reading the public text learns no criterion id, weight, dimension or probe value to special-case. Conforming-alternative probe: no public wording forces a grader-specific selector or literal; policy.md:5 explicitly says examples are 'not exact selectors, CSS classes or implementation requirements'. Positive: the brief is written in the user's voice and the notes describe behaviour without scoring language. Evidence-index note: its hosted run is on an earlier candidate and is not relied on for this row.
